question: In which of the following years was Sanskrit declared a Classical Language in India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**2005**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

 
• The Government of India declared **Sanskrit** as a Classical Language in **2005**, recognizing its rich heritage and historical significance.
 
• A language is categorized as "Classical" in India based on its rich literary tradition and antiquity of more than 1500-2000 years.
 
• Sanskrit is one of the oldest language
